The question is still cut off after "as of 2020," so I can't tell what fact you want, and my earlier population figure (about 1.1 billion in 2020) was only a guess. The team note is probably right that Congo's real income per person in 2020 was below its 1980 level, but I haven't verified that figure, and it doesn't establish that this single fact is what the region's growth record is built around. Send the full sentence and I'll answer that.

CONFIDENCE: 15
